theme: Light editorial theme (newsroom/paper feel) with dark accent sections
archetype: Swiss Brutalist & Old Money Tech Hybrid

headings.usage: Used for all primary headings, creating a high-end editorial newsroom feel. Very stylish, professional, anti-AI generative look.

body.usage: For readable body text, paragraphs, and general UI.

mono_data.usage: For data labels, tags, charts, numerical values, and 'technical' micro-copy.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle CSS noise overlay (grain) on light backgrounds to simulate a physical paper/print feel. Ensure it is very low opacity (2-3%).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D1D1C7 for structural grids, bento layouts, and tables. 'Border-collapse' style for technical sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Sharp, hard drop shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #0F0F0F) or completely flat with borders. No generic soft, floaty shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to maintain the editorial print vibe.

components_needed: lucide-react (Icons: ArrowRight, Check, LineChart, BarChart, PieChart, Sparkles, X, etc.)
framer-motion (For kinetic hero reveal, scroll animations, bento grid reveals)
Shadcn UI (Dialog/Modal for Enterprise Sales, Input, Button, Form, Tabs for chart switcher)

editorial_vibe.description: Person reading newspaper (Editorial luxury mood, use in background or atmospheric sections with low opacity)

layouts_and_grids.hero: Awwwards-level kinetic text. Massive serif typography for the headline. Line-by-line masked reveal on load using Framer Motion. Include an interactive 'Sample Query Demo' search bar. Logo is a bold black 'C'.
layouts_and_grids.marquee: Slow editorial marquee showing trusted sources or problem statements, separated by small dots or crosses.
layouts_and_grids.problems_section: Bento Grid (Mode A 'Tetris'). Show the 5 newsroom problems with stats. Use a dark accent background (#0A0A0A) with white text to create visual tension and contrast.

features.f1_deep_research: Split layout. Left: Sticky text describing research & verification. Right: Scrolling list of sources tracing claims.
features.f2_visualisation: Interactive container with Recharts. Add UI toggles for 'View: Line/Bar/Pie', 'Values: Absolute', 'Order', 'Zero Baseline', 'Copy Data', 'Export'. Highlight 'Anomalies detected' visually.
features.f3_connections: Grid or abstract visual showing dots connecting events, people, organizations. Emphasize discovering the bigger story.

layouts_and_grids.comparison: Side-by-side demo. Left: ChatGPT/Claude giving 'essay-style' responses. Right: Chople instantly formatting as an interactive Rechart. Below this: 8-10 row difference table with checkmarks for Chople.
layouts_and_grids.platform_page: A dedicated section (or second page route) mimicking the actual product UI interactively. Highlight '1-click notes with citations', '10 min vs 2 hours' research time, and 'Trends' connecting news feeds.
layouts_and_grids.footer: Massive typography. 'Contact Enterprise Sales' form (opens in Dialog). 'Join Waitlist' input form. Links to Twitter and LinkedIn.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for a premium momentum feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Framer motion scroll reveals for bento cards and feature images (fade in and translate up).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons have a sharp 1px border that fills with black on hover (inverse text). Chart toggles click instantly with small scale-down effect.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Include one subtle parallax moment on the platform UI screenshots to give them depth on scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, recharts, lucide-react.
Import Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono'. Apply them precisely to headings, body, and data elements.
Create a clean editorial aesthetic. Absolutely NO generic SaaS gradients, soft blurry shadows, or generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Ensure all interactive Recharts look like financial/editorial data (use sharp lines, no curved smoothing, precise mono fonts for axes).
Build the Comparison table to look like a high-end newspaper financial section table (thin borders, crisp typography, generous padding).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs for robust testing.
Do not center-align body text; keep paragraphs left-aligned to preserve the reading flow of a newsroom aesthetic.
Implement the Platform UI mimicking section meticulously, utilizing the provided product screenshots to show authentic UI features.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment, generous padding (p-8 to p-16 in sections), layered z-index depth, and glass-morphism sparingly only where needed. Avoid standard centered layouts. Inject subtle noise texture via CSS to give it a physical print feel. Do not use transparent backgrounds under text where readability is compromised.
